name: cache-timer
description: Counts down, in the prompt footer beside the model, the time left before the main thread's prompt cache lapses, so you know when the next message will pay to re-write it

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto: start at 1h and follow what the API reports (a model switch names it; a cache miss after 5 to 60 idle minutes means 5m, a hit means 1h). 1h or 5m: always count down from that.
